subject: general
question: A car’s odometer shows 3000 km at the beginning of a journey and 3200 km at the end. If the journey takes 4 hours, what is the car’s average speed?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net distance = End reading − Start reading

Net distance = 3200 − 3000 = 200 km

Average speed = Distance ÷ Time

Average speed = 200 ÷ 4 = 50 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 50 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Odometer reading at start = 3000 km

Odometer reading at end = 3200 km

Total journey time = 4 hours

Formula used: Average speed = (Total Distance covered) ÷ (Total Time taken)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c822858ff588f2859ee4158e7d4369427b9f2cc56f122f98a5674e9aff59180.png] 
⇒ Total Distance = Final Odometer Reading − Initial Odometer Reading
⇒ Total Distance = 3200 − 3000 = 200 km
⇒ Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time
⇒ Average Speed = 200 ÷ 4
⇒ Average Speed = 50 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 50 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed (Equal Distances)

If a journey covers two equal distances at speeds x and y, the average speed is 2xy ÷ (x + y).

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

Odometer vs. Speedometer

An odometer measures the total distance traveled by the vehicle, while a speedometer measures the instantaneous speed.</p
